"""E24: early questions that ask a fact the sources already state (#1289, item 4)."""
import json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

from analysis_service.assertions import settled
from analysis_service.early_questions import early_questions
from analysis_service.questions import prepared_model
from analysis_service.report import Report

KIND = {"internet-exposure": "reachability", "record-attribution": "audit-evidence"}
exposure = Counter()
catalog = Counter()
for path in sorted(Path("evals").rglob("*.report.json")):
    report = Report.model_validate_json(path.read_text())
    rows = report.assertions.catalog if report.assertions else None
    model = prepared_model(report.system_model, rows)
    frameworks = {s.name: s.options for s in report.job.frameworks}
    asked = early_questions(report.system_model, frameworks, rows)
    exposure["models"] += 1
    for question in asked:
        if question.key[4] != "reachability":
            continue
        element = model.get(question.key[0])
        value = getattr(element, "exposure", None)
        if value in ("internet-facing", "internal"):
            exposure["asked on a stated exposure"] += 1
            exposure["of them at or above the floor"] += question.score >= 1
    if rows is None:
        continue
    catalog["reports with a catalog"] += 1
    ids = {e.id for e in report.system_model.elements()}
    stated = {(r.subject, KIND[r.predicate]) for r in settled(rows)
              if r.predicate in KIND and not r.scope and r.subject in ids}
    catalog["settled unscoped rows on an element"] += len(stated)
    catalog["asked although stated"] += len(stated & {(q.key[0], q.key[4]) for q in asked})
print(json.dumps({"exposure": exposure, "catalog": catalog}, indent=2))
